blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 50 in June to 46 in September (−8.0%), and it took 7.5% of the city’s 240 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 43 in June to 28 in September (−34.9%), and it took 9.3% of the city’s 375 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Sunnyside Park for detached houses in June (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, August, September (a sellers’ best bet).

items.t: Surrey plan: the current Official Community Plan is the Surrey 2050 OCP, Bylaw No. 21900 — a City corporate report records that on June 15, 2026, Surrey 2050 OCP received final adoption from Council; the former PlanSurrey 2013 OCP, Bylaw No. 18020, is NOT current and is never cited as current here. Surrey Zoning Bylaw, 1993, No. 12000 governs; its SSMUH zones RA to R6 allow up to 3 units on lots under 280 sq m, up to 4 units on lots over 280 sq m, and up to 6 units on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop.

Secondary suites (Surrey): secondary suites in Surrey are capped at 40% of the principal dwelling's habitable floor area, one per dwelling; the old 90 m² cap is NOT a current rule and is never stated as current here.

Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan: approved by Council on January 31, 2022 and later updated to align with the King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit and the Surrey 2050 OCP designations; the plan area, 16 Avenue to 24 Avenue from Martin Drive to Earl Marriott Secondary School, borders this sub-area. The guide page states the plan covers 136 hectares and was updated on July 27, 2026 for King George Boulevard bus rapid transit (Corporate Report CR171) — site copy.

Flood / ALR and taxes: floodplain and ALR status for a specific lot in this sub-area are UNVERIFIED — check City flood information and Agricultural Land Commission maps by parcel. Property tax or levy notes specific to this sub-area: UNVERIFIED.

items.t: The whole in-sub-area apartment stock stands within a few blocks on one street. Semiahmoo Estates (2239 152 Street) and Odyssey (2620 152 Street) are both on 152 Street — a buyer who wants an apartment condo in Sunnyside Park is choosing between a 1990/1991 55+ wood-frame building and a 2025 wood-frame project, with nothing verified in between.

The 6 cards visible at reading were all detached houses and ranchers, while the board's September 2026 sub-area count shows attached product carrying the activity (32% ratio vs 7% detached) — a 6-card page snapshot and the board's monthly sub-area count measure different sets.

Surrey has a new Official Community Plan, and older citations are stale. The Surrey 2050 OCP (Bylaw No. 21900) received final adoption on June 15, 2026 — any older page or document citing the PlanSurrey 2013 OCP (Bylaw No. 18020) as current is out of date, including for the Semiahmoo Town Centre designations beside this sub-area.

Sunnyside Acres is protected by a vote, not just a plan. Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest, 2598 144 Street, is a 140-hectare second-growth forest that grew back after logging in the early 1900s, protected in perpetuity by a 1988 Surrey residents' vote, with about 4 km of trails including the 0.8 km Wally Ross universal access trail; Sunnyside Lawn Cemetery, 14850 28 Avenue, is a 28-acre City cemetery with burials since 1954, with part of the historic Semiahmoo Trail running through it (guide page, site copy).
Check the plan boundary before pricing growth upside.

No presale is verified inside the sub-area. No project in this sub-area was verified on a City development application page in the research read — presales: UNVERIFIED. Odyssey is complete (2025 per listings); do not price a Sunnyside purchase on an unnamed future project.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Sunnyside Park

items.t: Strata diligence — the Form B regime (all 4 counted complexes are strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. For Bishop's Green, St. Martin's Lane and Highgrove the Form B is also where any 55+ bylaw is actually proved — listing descriptions are not proof.

Presales (REDMA) — live here via Elisa: a presale buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18, deposits in trust) and has a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging it (REDMA s. 21). Apply that frame to any Elisa at Sunnyside Park purchase; assignment terms are UNCONFIRMED until the disclosure statement is read.

items.t: The corridor's filing split hides half the stock from a single-sub-area search. Peninsula Village (2500 152 St, King George Corridor filing) and Bishop's Green (2533 152 St, Sunnyside Park filing) stand a few blocks apart on the same street, both gated 55+-described townhouse complexes — a buyer searching only one sub-area's page misses the other.

Highgrove's own listings argue with each other about its age rule. "No age restrictions" in one listing, "55+ semidetached townhome" in another, for the same 15055 20 Avenue complex — the clearest local example of why an age claim is proved on the Form B's registered bylaws, never from listing copy.

The deleted townhomes page must stay deleted. sunnyside-park-surrey-townhomes-for-sale.html was intentionally deleted on October 23, 2026 and must return 404 with no internal links — its absence is expected, not a defect, and no page copy should link to it.

The newest townhouse supply here is a 31-unit presale across from the park the sub-area is named for. Elisa at Sunnyside Park (2669 154 St, by Hive) is sited across from Sunnyside Park at 15455 26 Avenue — the City park that shares the sub-area's name, a separate thing from both the sub-area and from Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest (2598 144 Street, roughly 140 hectares, about 4 km of trails). Three different "Sunnyside" references meet on one townhouse search.

The recreation centre and pool are not at the shopping centre. South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is at 14601 - 20 Ave and the South Surrey Indoor Pool at 14655 17 Avenue; Semiahmoo Library is at 1815 - 152nd Street — the amenity cluster for the 152 Street townhouses is the 20th/17th Avenue civic block, not Semiahmoo Shopping Centre.

Roads: 148 Street, 152 Street, 20 Avenue, 24 Avenue and King George Boulevard serve the area. Transit: route 321 runs Surrey Central Station to White Rock Centre / White Rock South via King George Boulevard and 152 Street, stopping at White Rock Centre near this area.

Parks: Bakerview Park, 1845 - 154 Street, has Sunnyside Community Hall, a garden, playground, baseball diamonds and a soccer field; Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 Street, is a roughly 140-hectare second-growth forest with about 4 kilometres of trails including the Wally Ross universal access trail, and the Semiahmoo Trail runs through this part of South Surrey.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Sunnyside Park

items.t: Secondary suites: one secondary suite may be permitted in a single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling, capped at 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable floor area under Zoning Bylaw No. 12000, one suite per unit; a suite is NOT a separate strata lot. The old 90 m² cap is NOT a current rule.

Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan: the plan was approved by Council and later updated to align with the King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit and the Surrey 2050 OCP designations; the plan area, 16 Avenue to 24 Avenue from Martin Drive to Earl Marriott Secondary School, borders this sub-area.

ALR rules — framework only, no ALR ground documented here: where a parcel is in the ALR, subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); BC Assessment farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Bare-land strata / strata block: If a lot elsewhere in Surrey is bare-land strata, the BC position is: a bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure — Form B diligence (provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page), depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023, rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022, and only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2 with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sunnyside Park Surrey than in June?
faq.a: In Sunnyside Park Surrey, listings of houses fell from 50 in June to 46 in September (−8.0%); condos and townhomes fell from 43 in June to 28 in September (−34.9%).

faq.q: How big is Sunnyside Park Surrey compared with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sunnyside Park Surrey held 7.7% of the 600 houses listed in South Surrey and White Rock and 4.7% of the 593 condos and townhomes listed in South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sunnyside Park Surrey from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 18 houses and 35 condos and townhomes sold in Sunnyside Park Surrey over those 4 months.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Sunnyside Park Surrey?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Sunnyside Park Surrey?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: How many apartment-condo buildings are actually in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: Everything else attached in the sub-area is townhouses (Peninsula Village, Bishop's Green) or detached houses.

faq.q: Is Peninsula Village a condo building?
faq.a: No. Peninsula Village (2500 152 Street) is a gated townhouse complex built in 1993 — townhouse strata lots with a clubhouse and a private gate to the Peninsula Village Shopping Centre.

faq.q: The directory says Semiahmoo Estates bans rentals and pets. What is actually enforceable?
faq.a: Rentals: a long-term rental-restriction bylaw has been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, so the directory's "rentals not allowed" line is old bylaw text. Pets: pet bylaws remain enforceable, and the directory records pets not allowed — read the registered bylaws. Age: the directory records age restrictions and listings describe a 55+ community; a 55+ bylaw is the one age bylaw BC law still allows.

faq.q: How old is Semiahmoo Estates, exactly?
faq.a: The sources conflict: the building directory states 1991, while MLS listings and the building's MLS data sheet state 1990.

faq.q: What is Odyssey, and is it finished?
faq.a: Odyssey by Forge Properties is two 4-storey wood-frame low-rises with 132 condominiums between 152 Street and King George Boulevard (presale-directory source, secondary); current listings record units as built 2025 at both addresses, so the buildings are complete and trading as resales/developer sales, not as a future presale.

faq.q: How many townhouse complexes are actually in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: Four verified strata complexes filed under Sunnyside Park Surrey — Bishop's Green (2533 152 St), St. No fee-simple townhouse complex was verified.

faq.q: Is Highgrove a 55+ complex or not?
faq.a: UNCONFIRMED — the listings conflict in terms: one states "no age restrictions," another describes a unit as a "55+ semidetached townhome." The registered bylaws on the Form B decide it; do not buy, or pass, on either listing line alone.

faq.q: Do both of us have to be 55 to live in Bishop's Green or St. Martin's Lane?
faq.a: Provincially, a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption) is exempt, as are live-in caregivers and legacy residents (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, Reg 7.01 as expanded May 1, 2023). Peninsula Village listings next door state the common local form expressly — "One person 55+" — but each complex's own bylaw wording must be confirmed in its Form B.
